Package com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update

Class UpdateInstaller

java.lang.Object
com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.UpdateInstaller
public class UpdateInstaller extends Object
Replaces the running JAR with a freshly downloaded one.

The last two steps of an installation are inherently destructive for the running JVM: a platform specific script is launched and the JVM exits. Both are isolated in protected methods (launchUpdateScript(Path) and exitForRestart()) so they can be replaced in tests, and the directory holding the generated script is injectable so tests never write into the real ~/.lg3d/updates folder.

    • installOnExit

      public void installOnExit(Path newJarFile, Path existingBackup) throws UpdateException
      Applies a staged update when the JVM exits, without relaunching it.

      Used by the auto-install feature: the platform script waits for the file lock to be released, replaces the running JAR and stops, so the new version takes effect the next time the user launches Project Looking Glass. Unlike installUpdate(Path, Path) this never calls exitForRestart() and is therefore safe to run from a shutdown hook.

      Parameters:
      newJarFile - verified JAR to apply
      existingBackup - rollback archive prepared by the caller, may be null
      Throws:
      UpdateException - when the deferred installation cannot be prepared

    • launchUpdateScript
